verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — Brent $95.45 Is $1.55 From Regime Trigger; PPI Binary at 8:30 AM ET
verdict.rationale_short: The US completed its latest Iran strikes overnight, generating a pre-market futures relief rally (ES +0.87%, NQ +1.1%) — but Brent climbed to $95.45 (+2.52%) in the process, closing to within $1.55 of the $97 oil regime trigger. Four of five regime indicators remain in breach: VIX 20.75 (above 18), 30Y ~5.00% (at threshold), SPX 7,267 (193 pts below 7,460 floor), Brent $95.45 (approaching $97). DXY retreated to 99.80 — the sole cleared indicator — but that reversal is contingent on today's 8:30 AM ET May PPI print not re-igniting dollar demand. Consensus is +0.7% m/m headline / +0.4% core; a print at or above consensus keeps the 30Y pinned at 5.0% and prevents any regime recovery. SPCX prices today at $135 (capital drain climax completing), ADBE reports after close (AI-eats-software binary). STEP ASIDE is unchanged from the June 10 night brief: raise cash, hold IWM short, do not add new long exposure until the oil trigger clears and SPX reclaims 7,380.

bear_case: Brent at $95.45 is $1.55 from the oil regime trigger — the price move was driven by fresh US military strikes on Iran overnight, and Iran responded with new missile and drone attacks on US assets in Jordan and the Persian Gulf. The US's 'completed strikes' framing signals a tactical pause, not a ceasefire; Iranian sea mines remain physically present in the Strait of Hormuz, and a single tanker incident or IDF strike on Iranian oil infrastructure converts STEP ASIDE to BEARISH in a single session. May PPI at 8:30 AM ET at consensus (+0.7% m/m) keeps the 30Y pinned at 5.0% and sets up a difficult June 17 FOMC where Warsh must navigate stagflation dynamics — hot headline inflation driven by oil with below-2% core — without clear policy tools. ADBE reporting after today's close with the stock down 30% YTD introduces a second evening binary: a Digital Media ARR miss would extend the AI-deflation narrative from hardware capex (ORCL, AVGO) to software multiples across the entire AI-adoption stack, hitting MSFT, GOOGL, and META on read-through. Asia closed broadly lower overnight (Nikkei −1.06%, Hang Seng −0.88%), providing no constructive technical floor for the US pre-market bounce. **Invalidation: If PPI prints ≤0.4% m/m core AND Brent settles back below $92 on Iran de-escalation, STEP ASIDE converts to HOLD at tomorrow's open. If Brent breaks $97 intraday, BEARISH verdict activates immediately — do not wait for EOD close.**
